text.tspan: Official development assistance to least-developed countries 2000 to 2024
Net official development assistance from OECD Development Assistance Committee donors to least-developed
countries. This data is expressed in constant US dollars. It is adjusted for inflation but does not account for
differences in living costs between countries.

tspan.tspan: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
This data is expressed in constant 2022 US$.
